input_pool: P4b frozen candidate_pool.json joined exactly by candidate_id to results.jsonl

methods.B4: protected original incumbent first; all lower-successful candidates eligible; stable candidate_id order for the remainder
methods.B5: B4 eligibility and incumbent protection; remainder sorted by total DMA bytes, load calls, candidate_id
methods.B6: B4 eligibility and incumbent protection; complete available static request-shape Pareto fronts with stable dense rank-sum and candidate_id tie-break
methods.B7: exploratory mode-diverse B6 order with protected incumbent first and best available input/weight/hybrid representatives before Pareto fill; no mode-benefit claim

incumbent_policy: protected original incumbent must remain first in every strategy and budget
failure_policy: P4b lower failures are categorized and charged to local screening, but never enter board shortlists
claims_forbidden: board performance measured by this run
weight or hybrid mode benefit inferred from B7 diversity
